questions.question: Which animal barks?
questions.explanation: A "dog" is the animal that barks.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence about her car:
questions.explanation: With "she" (third person) we use "has", not "have".

questions.question: What time is it? 3:00
questions.explanation: To say the time on the hour we use "o'clock": "It's three o'clock".

questions.question: Complete: "___ you like coffee?"
questions.explanation: For questions with "you" in the present simple we use "Do": "Do you like coffee?".

questions.question: What is the plural of "child"?
questions.explanation: "Child" has an irregular plural: "children".

questions.question: Which word refers to the day before today?
questions.explanation: "Yesterday" refers to the day before today.

questions.question: Complete: "I ___ to the gym every day."
questions.explanation: With "I" in the present simple we use the base form: "I go".

questions.question: Which word means the same as "large"?
questions.explanation: "Big" means the same as "large".

questions.question: Complete: "My mother ___ a teacher."
questions.explanation: With "my mother" (she) the verb "to be" is "is".

questions.question: Which fruit is yellow and curved?
questions.explanation: A "banana" is a yellow, curved fruit.

questions.question: Complete: "There ___ a book on the desk."
questions.explanation: With a singular subject ("a book") we use "there is".

questions.question: Which word names a body part used for hearing?
questions.explanation: The "ear" is the body part used for hearing.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence about the keys:
questions.explanation: For plural nouns close to us we use "these are".

questions.question: Which season comes after winter?
questions.explanation: "Spring" comes right after winter.

questions.question: Complete: "They ___ from Canada."
questions.explanation: With "they" the verb "to be" is "are".

questions.question: Which item of clothing covers your head?
questions.explanation: A "hat" is worn to cover your head.

questions.question: Choose the correct question:
questions.explanation: Present simple questions with "you" need "do": "Where do you live?".

questions.question: Which number comes after nine?
questions.explanation: "Ten" is the number that comes right after nine.

questions.question: Which piece of furniture do people sleep on?
questions.explanation: A "bed" is the piece of furniture people sleep on.

questions.question: Complete: "He can ___ very fast."
questions.explanation: After "can" we always use the base form of the verb: "can run".

questions.question: Which word describes hot, sunny weather?
questions.explanation: "Sunny" describes hot weather with a lot of sun.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence about the book:
options: This is book on the table.
This is a book on the table.
This is an book on the table.
This a book on the table.
questions.explanation: "Book" starts with a consonant sound, so we use "a book".

questions.question: Which family member is your mother's mother?
questions.explanation: Your mother's mother is your "grandmother".

questions.question: Complete: "The cat is ___ the box."
questions.explanation: "In" describes something inside a container like a box.

questions.question: Which job involves flying an airplane?
questions.explanation: A "pilot" is the person who flies an airplane.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence about the pen:
questions.explanation: With "I" the negative present simple uses "don't": "I don't have".

questions.question: Which color do you get by mixing blue and yellow?
questions.explanation: Mixing blue and yellow makes "green".

questions.question: Complete: "Whose bag is this? It's ___ bag."
questions.explanation: "Her" is the possessive adjective used before a noun: "her bag".

questions.question: Which vehicle travels on train tracks?
questions.explanation: A "train" is the vehicle that travels on train tracks.

questions.question: Which month comes right before December?
questions.explanation: "November" comes right before December.

questions.question: Complete: "___ is your favorite color?"
questions.explanation: We use "what" to ask about things, like a favorite color.

questions.question: Which school object do you use to write?
questions.explanation: A "pencil" is a school object used for writing.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence about the shelf:
options: The book are on the shelf.
The books is on the shelf.
The books are on the shelf.
The book am on the shelf.
questions.explanation: With the plural noun "books" the verb "to be" is "are".

questions.question: Which day comes right before Saturday?
questions.explanation: "Friday" comes right before Saturday.

questions.question: Complete: "The keys are ___ the table, next to the lamp."
questions.explanation: "On" describes something resting on top of a surface like a table.

questions.question: Which drink is usually made from coffee beans?
questions.explanation: "Coffee" is the drink made from coffee beans.

questions.question: Complete: "___ are those people?" "They are my cousins."
questions.explanation: We use "who" to ask about people.

questions.question: Which body part do you use to walk?
questions.explanation: You use your "feet" to walk.

questions.question: Choose the correct question about tea:
questions.explanation: In present simple questions with "she", we use "does" plus the base verb: "does she like".

questions.question: Which weather word describes a lot of white snow falling?
questions.explanation: "Snowy" describes weather with a lot of snow falling.

questions.question: Complete: "He is ___ engineer."
questions.explanation: "Engineer" starts with a vowel sound, so we use "an".

questions.question: Which family member is your father's brother?
questions.explanation: Your father's brother is your "uncle".

questions.question: What time is it? 7:30
questions.explanation: We can say the hour and minutes together: "seven thirty".

questions.question: Which number is one more than twelve?
questions.explanation: "Thirteen" is one more than twelve.

questions.question: Complete: "I ___ swim, but I can't play the piano."
questions.explanation: "Can" is used to talk about ability: "I can swim".

questions.question: Which piece of furniture do you sit on at a desk?
questions.explanation: A "chair" is the piece of furniture you sit on.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence about the apples:
options: There is many apples in the basket.
There be many apples in the basket.
There am many apples in the basket.
There are many apples in the basket.
questions.explanation: With the plural noun "apples" we use "there are".

questions.question: Which job takes care of sick people in a hospital?
questions.explanation: A "nurse" takes care of sick people in a hospital.

questions.question: Complete: "___ do you go to school?" "By bus."
questions.explanation: We use "how" to ask about the way something is done, like traveling by bus.

questions.question: Which item of clothing do you wear when it is cold, on your hands?
questions.explanation: "Gloves" are worn on your hands to keep warm.
